SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
DesktopLauncher
Starts the desktop (LWJGL3) application.
GameApplication
Root LibGDX Game managing shared rendering resources and screen transitions.
GameAudio
Plays the sound effects and the musics of the game (GDD 4).
GameScreen
Main gameplay screen rendering the TiledMap arena, minimap pass, and the Scene2D Hud.
Hud
Scene2D HUD displaying the health bar, coin counter, 3 quick-access slots, and minimap frame.
HudState
Pure-Java model holding HUD values (HP, coins, 3 quick-access slots, and player position).
InventoryPageState
Pure-Java model of the inventory page (GDD 1.4, Q58): whether it is open, which slot is selected and whether a Switch is pending.
MenuFlowState
Pure-Java state machine controlling startup menu, mode selection, and character selection.
MenuFlowState.GameMode
Available game modes, each with the map it is played on.
MenuFlowState.HeroType
Character archetypes displayed on the selection screen (1 playable in PoC).
MenuFlowState.ScreenStep
Steps in the menu navigation flow.
MenuScreen
Renders the Startup Menu (Play/Quit), Mode Selection (Arena/Endless), and 3-Hero Selection.
MusicTrack
The musics of the game (GDD 4.3), each streamed from music/<file>.ogg: an intro played once, then a loop that repeats until another music takes over.
PageSlot
A slot of the inventory page.
PageSlot.Kind
What a slot of the page holds.
PassiveSwap
Two passive slots to swap, asked by a Switch on the inventory page.
ShopPageState
Pure-Java model of the shop page (GDD 1.4): whether it is open, and the shopkeeper it trades with.
SoundEffect
The short sound effects of the game (GDD 4.2), each loaded whole into memory from sounds/<file>.ogg so it plays with no delay.
SoundEvents
Turns game events into sound effects (GDD 4.2): one attack sound per attack, heard from the attacker, and one damage sound per character hit, heard from the one hit.
StartupHelper
Game startup helper for LWJGL3.
UiSkinFactory
Loads ui/hud/uiskin.json and injects fallback Label and TextButton styles.
